notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/9a9b2eef8c88ebed82ed8986880cee2a2da818e4.png"][/img][/p][h1]Hello friends![/h1][p]Five months of Early Access already… can you believe it? It feels like just yesterday we were panicking while hitting the release button on Steam, and now here we are… still very much caffeinated. Still working hard. But, most of all, still so grateful to all of you![/p][p]These months have been filled with bug hunting, balancing, optimising, and more than a few “why is that broken now?” moments. But they’ve also been full of joy thanks to your amazing feedback, comments, suggestions, and endless support. Thanks to you, Little Sim World is already a much smoother, cosier, and funnier experience than it was at launch.[/p][p]Today, we want to celebrate your help by sharing everything we’ve improved since release, what’s coming next, and one special announcement: [b]a brand-new feature we’re introducing in this update![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]What We've Done So Far[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]✅ Added a bunch of new things[/h3][list][*][p]100+ new clothes and accessories[/p][/*][*][p]50+ pieces of furniture and building materials[/p][/*][*][p]10+ new food recipes and ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]70+ new collectables[/p][/*][*][p]35+ Steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Many new animations[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects, including voice-over for NPCs[/p][/*][/list][h3]✅ Improved performance[/h3][list][*][p]Huge back-end optimisation: the game runs much more smoothly now[/p][/*][*][p]No more stuttering on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Can run on even lower-spec PCs[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller input and native mapping[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the pesky double-click issue on Mac[/p][/*][*][p]Increased player walking and running speed[/p][/*][/list][h3]✅ Balancing adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Expanded inventory slots[/p][/*][*][p]Slower needs decrease[/p][/*][*][p]University classes are now only mandatory once per day, three times a week[/p][list][*][p]Despite this being a life sim, university won’t take over your whole time like in real life![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Weather is far less punishing[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to restart quests so players won’t get stuck if a bug interrupts progress[/p][/*][/list][h3]✅…And a lot of bugs squashed![/h3][h3] [/h3][h2]What’s Coming Next[/h2][hr][/hr][list][*][p][b]Relationship system:[/b] soon you’ll be able to progress in your relationship level with most NPCs[/p][/*][*][p][b]World interactions:[/b] more fun activities around Little London[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gardening:[/b] get ready to grow your own crops in your little backyard[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]And now… ready for the news?[/b][/h3][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes v0.53.00 [/h1][p][/p][h2]New Features:[/h2][hr][/hr][h3][b]🛠️ New Tutorial[/b][/h3][p]We’ve given the tutorial a big upgrade to make learning the game smoother and more enjoyable for new players. With clearer pointers, simplified text, and fewer pop-ups, completing the tutorial is now quicker and easier than ever.[/p][p]Don’t worry, all lessons are still available anytime in the Lessons app, so you can revisit them whenever you need a refresher.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🏙️ City Residents[/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to introduce a brand-new feature: [b]City Residents[/b]! After lots of work behind the scenes, the streets are now alive with permanent townsfolk, adding chatter, charm, and a whole new layer of atmosphere to Little London.[/p][p]These residents also follow a schedule, just like the rest of our lovely townsfolk. Sometimes you’ll see them chatting with each other, sometimes on the phone, or simply relaxing. This is only the beginning. Soon, residents will become interactable, asking for your help in quests, or just chatting to you and bringing even more life to the world. Keep your eyes peeled for the next few patch updates for more fun features coming soon![/p][p][/p][h2]Updates:[/h2][hr][/hr][h3][b]⚖️ Balancing Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reworked map pins[/p][/*][*][p]Map now shows your character’s head, and the pin colour matches your favourite colour[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the frequency of Yaps in Multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial experience improved[/p][/*][*][p]Updated quest markers in the world and map to be bigger and animate correctly for better visibility[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎮 Controller Support & Steam Deck[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added support for input keys to be included in localisation with controller and rebind compatibility[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📊 UI Fixes & Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the catalogue so stock is kept correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the catalogue basket so it doesn’t overflow[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the catalogue basket so items not added are removed correctly when closing[/p][/*][*][p]Updated catalogue text to use “Add to Basket” instead of “Purchase”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pop-ups sometimes appearing twice after returning to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI elements above the HUD so they wait in queue before showing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the interaction menu being disabled when opening during a hiding animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the virtual keyboard appearing when loading the game out of focus[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎯 General Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]NPCs should now sit in their chairs more reliably[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pedestal items remaining active after being purchased[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed CC birthdays saving correctly when randomised[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐛Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]On Linux systems such as Steam Deck, the Quest app’s virtual mouse may not work correctly in full screen if you’re not using Proton. We recommend manually switching to Proton until Steam approves our automatic update. Alternatively, you can use the right D-Pad or Touchpad to open the Quest app in full screen, and the virtual mouse will work as a workaround.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i][b]Please remember to update your game on Steam so the patch can be applied! [/b][/i][b]🔄️[/b][/p]

notes.content:
[h1]Hello friends![/h1][p][/p][p]It’s been almost two months since Little Sim World launched into Early Access—and what a ride this has been! Between squashing bugs like a mole-in-a-hole game, reading through the amazing suggestions and feedback we’ve been getting, and crying at broken things that weren’t broken yesterday… Well, basically we’ve had our hands full, but our hearts have been even fuller.[/p][p][/p][p]First of all: thank you so, so much! [list]
[*] Butter Chicken recipe now also requires... Well... Chicken.

Little Sim World version v0.52.5

[list]

Send us messages on the bug-report channel if you face any issues with these.
[*] A weird bug that causes people to see golden bubbles during activities that should not give them those.
[/list]

More to come soon!

notes.title: Cool features you'll see in Early Access on May 1st!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey friends![/h1]

Can you believe it? Little Sim World comes to Early Access in [b]just one week[/b]. ONE. WEEK. We’ve been pouring our hearts into this game for years now, and it still feels surreal that we’re this close.

We’re [strike]panicking[/strike] working hard to bring you the best possible experience for Early Access. And since you’ve probably seen the main features by now, we thought we’d take this opportunity to talk about 7 of the ones we haven’t covered as much yet—and that you can expect to find when you move into Little London next week, on [b]May 1st![/b]


[hr][/hr]
[h1]1. Weather & Clothes[/h1]

Windy autumn days, scorching summer afternoons, snowy winter mornings—as the seasons change, so does the temperature and weather. And your Little feels it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/dc806ca51a7baf2b6d2c0051a802a0f1b509e69a.png[/img]
Clothes in Little Sim World aren’t just about style—they directly affect how the weather impacts you. Check the Forecast app on your phone in the mornings, and plan your outfit accordingly to keep your Little happy and comfy throughout the day!

[h1]2. Bills[/h1]

Bills? In this cosy economy?? Well, yeah—this is a life sim after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/c75ad48a593930473f4328d359f08ed0861b4679.png[/img]
Every 2 weeks, your bills will arrive straight to your mailbox. They break down everything—electricity, heating, internet—so you can see exactly where your Crowns are going. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/66472fefe980d69157e365b9db0ae7491e2cb0dd.png[/img]
You can pay them at The Royal Snail, or make life easier by grabbing the Bills app for your phone. Just don’t forget the due date… Or you’ll get slapped with a fine!

[h1]3. Premium Paints & Dyes[/h1]

Ah, yes. Nothing says “I’ve got it together” like a purple fridge that matches your purple hair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/88bb9341d58e052e57ec9b5e6545aed560172596.png[/img]
You can recolour your hair, clothes, furniture, and appliances with both primary and secondary colour options. To unlock preset colours, just buy the matching paint or dye. But if you want to see how many shades of pink your stuff can be, premium dyes and paints will unlock a colour wheel so you can pick any tone you like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/dd3bdc15ca2cdc0e22ee4691f8c292e37b2fed02.png[/img]
[h1]4. Bus Stops[/h1]

Running late? Feet tired? Raining again? No worries, there’s a bus stop right in front of your house!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/cfe1f607e925123d960d6bcdeadb22db0b6c46c4.png[/img]
For $3.50 Crowns, you can hop on and get dropped off at any of the stops scattered around Little London. No need to trek across town on foot under the blazing summer sun—unless, of course, you’re into that!

[h1]5. Make a Wish[/h1]

Little London is full of charm—and a few mysterious fountains too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/ba9f3a93529dfb53b05e9c9171a9a499592e21cb.png[/img]
You’ll spot them in parks and tucked around the city, and once a day, you can toss in a coin and make a wish. Most days, it’s just for the vibe… But if you’re lucky, the fountain might surprise you with a collectible. No promises though!

[h1]6. Necessities[/h1]

Your Little deserves nice things, like a gentle fabric softener or a cute rubber duck for bath time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/bc6b841c75f458ee524e3f4b9debd03ac39f736a.png[/img]
You’ll find everyday essentials at the grocery shop: liquid soap, detergent, toilet paper, kitchen spray, toothpaste, and all the little things that keep you and your home feeling fresh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/e81cd09f38f8ebbc0ec0c8e530d41a696fa1f95b.png[/img]
And these aren’t just for show! A good shampoo gives your Little a clean, happy boost for the day, and having detergent on hand means your sink won’t turn into a disaster zone after every meal. In Little Sim World, the small things make a big difference!

[h1]7. Recipes App[/h1]

Are you the kind who steps into the grocery shop and immediately forgets what you went in for? We got you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39121659/2ff6b3f8cea04463b082bcab8281dff89d368d08.png[/img]
The Recipes app on your phone lets you select meals you want to cook—or items you want to craft—and makes a handy shopping list before you even leave the house. Now you can forget things on purpose, not by accident!

[hr][/hr]
There’s so much more in Little Sim World we could talk about but honestly? What we’re most excited for is watching you discover it all for yourself next week when Early Access hits!

Which of these features is your favourite? Let us know!!


With a [b]lot[/b] of love,

[h3][i]—Team LSW[/i][/h3]
